entity.description: Bear Point Harbor is your paradise destination on the Intracoastal Waterway. We provide quality fuel, supplies, laundry facilities, showers, friendly service and much more. Facilities Our facilities will make you feel right at home while you're docked with us. Dock Store Whether you're fueling up or getting supplies, our Dock Store has you covered. Fishing Charters, Cruises & Boat Rentals Book a Fishing Charter, rent a boat or take a relaxing dolphin cruise.
